<function name="GetTextColor" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns the "override" text color, set by <page>DLabel:SetTextColor</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Color">The <page>Color</page> of the text, or nil.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
